target.target_biology: Bifunctional folate biosynthesis enzyme essential for parasite thymidylate and DNA synthesis.
target.reference_note: Known clinical antifolates (Pyrimethamine, Methotrexate) are tagged as reference drugs to honestly inspect out-of-domain recall limits.
